Healing
happens
here

We are our community’s only federally qualified health center exclusively providing care to those affected by homelessness.

Mission

The mission of Healthcare for the Homeless - Houston is to promote health, hope and dignity for those affected by homelessness through accessible and comprehensive quality care.

Vision

Our vision is to provide pathways for moving beyond the cycle of homelessness through integrated healthcare and collaborative partnerships.

HHH offers free services for people who are literally living on the streets, in shelters, in transitional or permanent supportive housing and for those who are at-risk of homelessness.

Insurance is not required, and we never charge a co-pay for services.

Our Programs

  • Primary Medical Care

    Our primary medical care services offer comprehensive and accessible treatments, promoting wellness and continuity of care within a supportive setting.

  • Dental Care

    Our dental clinic provides exams, cleanings, fillings, extractions and restorations alongside oral hygiene education and personalized treatment plans.

  • Vision and Opthalmology

    We provide vision screenings, eye exams, and host an annual vision fair providing prescription eye glasses.

  • Podiatry

    Our bi-monthly podiatry clinic provides treatment, preventive care and footwear solutions to promote mobility and overall well-being.

  • Integrated Mental Health

    Our integrated mental health services ensure emotional and practical needs are met, fostering holistic well-being through counseling, therapy and psychiatry.

  • Behavioral Health

    Our behavioral health services offer compassionate counseling and resources to empower individuals on their path to stability and recovery.

  • Well Women's Care

    Our well-women's care program provides essential medical services, reproductive health support and a safe space for holistic wellness for homeless women.

  • Pediatric Medicine

    At the Reed Family Clinic, we provide children with comprehensive medical care, developmental guidance and psychosocial services.

  • Case Management and Care Coordination

    For whole-person care, we offer one-on-one support and connection to essential resources, medical care and social services.

  • Transportation

    We operate the city’s only bus program providing access to 23 health centers, service agencies and shelters exclusively for individuals affected by homelessness.

  • Clinical Education

    Our clinical education program offers medical students valuable hands-on experience while providing homeless individuals with much-needed healthcare services in a compassionate and empowering environment.
